messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — profiler shows a regression after we split init (prefill) and gen (decode) queues on canary. p99 latency up ~18% and tail CPU stalls on kernels when KV miss rate > 6%.

sam: Oof. Any flamegraphs? Is it a scheduling artifact or kernel mismatch?

mira: Pasted sample from perf top + trace:

```
p99_latency: 48ms -> 57ms
cpu_stalls: kernel_select_wait 120ms spikes
kv_miss_rate: 6.8% (hot shards)
batcher: avg batch size prefill=4 decode=2 (after split)
```

mira: Observations: separating queues reduced decode batching so kernel picks less optimal matmul tiling; plus KV cache thrash because small prefill batches cause more KV warms per request.

lee: Could be token_budget targets too low for prefill. We're slicing budgets evenly; that's not workload-aware.

ana: Agreed. I pushed a quick experiment last night increasing prefill token_budget to 24 and decode to 40, saw improved batching but still tail spikes on cold KV.

jon: Can we change routing to allow dynamic phase coalescing when model seq_len small? e.g. merge prefill+first decode into single batch for first N tokens.

sam: That sounds promising. Might need handshake changes though. Also check kernel affinity — if decode smaller batches pick different kernel leading to extra kernel switch overhead.

mira: Proposed candidate config (canary only):

```
batcher.phase_aware: true
batcher.token_budget = { "init": 20, "gen": 44 }
scheduler.coalesce_threshold = 8
scheduler.kernel_hint = "prefer_matmul_large" if batch_size >= 6
kv.priming_window_ms = 120
```

ops-bot: deploy-job queued: canary-batcher-tweaks-1718204321

ana: I'll run microbench with kv priming enabled and record p50/p95/p99 across seq lengths 16/64/256.

lee: Also add a tiny sampling profiler for kernel_select latency — we need to see how often the runtime switches kernel between prefill & decode on path.

mira: Action items: ana run microbench, lee add kernel_select sample, jon prototype coalesce handshaker, sam watch canary metrics (p95/p99 and KV miss rate). I'll open a tracking issue.

sam: thx. If we still see tail spikes we revert and investigate kernel fallback path.

ana: noted, starting runs now. will post summary here in ~45m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jon: ping me once samples land, happy to help debug handshaker

mira: thanks team :rocket:
